title: Total Amount Auto-Sync from Registration to Payment QR Section

requirements.summary: Save total amount to localStorage on 'Proceed to Payment' button click and navigate to Payment page
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Proceed to Payment' writes the current total amount (without ₹) to localStorage key 'vibecxAmount'.
The value written matches exactly what is shown in the total amount display on the Registration page.
Navigation to the Payment page occurs after saving the value.

file_operations.description: Modify the handleProceedToPayment function to extract the displayed total amount (numeric value without ₹ symbol), save it to localStorage under key 'vibecxAmount', then navigate to the Payment page. The totalAmount state already holds the numeric value, so use totalAmount.toString() as the source. Ensure the localStorage.setItem call occurs before the navigate call to guarantee the value is available on the Payment page.

requirements.summary: Read amount from localStorage on Payment page load and display in QR section without recalculation
acceptanceCriteria: On Payment page load, the QR section displays the amount as '₹<value>' where value matches what was saved by the Registration page.
A hidden input field holds the raw numeric amount from localStorage.
The Payment page performs no independent fee calculation.
If no amount is found in localStorage, the QR amount area is handled gracefully (e.g., shows a fallback or empty state).
The displayed QR amount is identical to the total shown on the Registration page before navigation.

file_operations.description: Add a useEffect hook that runs on component mount to read 'vibecxAmount' from localStorage. Display the retrieved amount as '₹<amount>' in a visible element within the QR section (create or modify an existing element to show the formatted amount). Add a hidden input field (e.g., <input type="hidden" id="paymentAmountInput" />) and populate it with the raw numeric value from localStorage. If no value is found in localStorage, display a graceful fallback message or empty state (e.g., '₹0' or 'Amount not available'). Do not perform any fee calculation logic on this page—only use the stored value from localStorage.
